title: Alembic redundancy and stale logic cleanup
purpose: Re-verify the 2026-06-11 six-agent audit findings, fix docs-vs-reality drift, restore Core headless determinism, remove verified-dead remnants, single-source shared Alembic/AlembicPlugin assets behind a drift gate, and convert structural debt into design candidates without implementing it.
globalUserDecisions: Scope is locked to the five product repositories: Alembic, AlembicCore, AlembicAgent, AlembicDashboard, AlembicPlugin.
Remove redundant code and stale logic outside each repository's declared responsibility; preserve all behavior.
AlembicDashboard receives no cleanup wave this sequence (audit grade A); it participates in validation only.
Structural refactors (layer sinking, V1/V2 convergence, MemoryStore ownership, Dashboard artifact pipeline) require design decisions first and must not be executed inside this sequence.
claimRules: Claim at most one demand at a time.
RC0 must complete before any product cleanup package is dispatched.
Delete only items RC0 marked delete-ready; migrate-first items need consumer migration evidence before removal.
Intentional Alembic/AlembicPlugin divergence is documented, never merged, in this sequence.
If a removal candidate has an ambiguous external consumer, mark it keep-with-reason or escalate to RC6 instead of deleting silently.
Final RC7 acceptance must review raw evidence, not target summaries.

items.title: Cleanup Readiness Scan
items.goal: Re-verify medium/low-confidence audit findings with consumer scans across all five repositories and build the per-item cleanup readiness matrix.
items.completionDefinition: Every audit item A3-A7, C1, C3, G1-G5, P2-P4 and the shared-asset drift table has a verification record, current-consumer list, delete-ready status, owning demand, validation command, and stop condition.

initialTaskPackages.summary: Verify audit findings and build the RC1-RC6 cleanup dispatch matrix.
initialTaskPackages.targetSummary: Run the nine verification tasks against current code and produce the readiness matrix with raw scan evidence.

items.title: Alembic Docs & Stale Artifact Cleanup
items.goal: Align AGENTS.md with the post-Wave-4/5 tree, archive tracked scratch decisions to the ledger, and remove verified stale remnants in the main repository.
items.completionDefinition: AGENTS.md matches the real lib/ tree and Dashboard artifact reality; git tracks no scratch decision documents; deprecated search helper and disabled tests carry RC0 verdicts applied; empty skills/ directory resolved; build, tests, and boundary lints green.

items.title: Core Headless Boundary Restoration
items.goal: Move the interactive discoverer prompt out of Core to its consumer layer, replace the random pruning trigger with a deterministic counter, and record the migration-gap verdict in-tree.
items.completionDefinition: No readline/stdin code in Core product paths; Math.random remains only in HnswIndex with documentation; migration 002/003 gap explained in-tree; Core suite, public-api boundary, release readiness, smoke, and downstream builds green with unchanged consumer-visible behavior.

items.title: Agent Hygiene & Boundary Config Hardening
items.goal: Fix or remove the broken probe script, encode core-import referenceLimits, compute public-api expectedCounts mechanically, and register V1 tool retirement and MemoryStore ownership intent.
items.completionDefinition: tmp/ has no broken imports; core-import lint fails on un-allowlisted subpaths (demonstrated); public-api lint computes counts (demonstrated failure on mismatch); V1 retirement register and MemoryStore boundary note exist; check gate and pack-preview green.

items.title: Plugin Docs, Legacy Governance & Surface Pruning
items.goal: Rewrite the README for plugin scope, delete or deadline-mark every legacy compatibility path into a legacy register, prune routes without plugin-runtime consumers, add scratch retention, and document the vendor snapshot flow.
items.completionDefinition: README is plugin-scoped; docs/legacy-register.md covers all remaining legacy paths with owner and retirement condition; every remaining HTTP route has a named consumer; scratch retention script exists and ran once supervised; vendor refresh documented; vitest, repo-boundary lint, smoke, and MCP samples green.

items.title: Shared Asset Single-Sourcing & Drift Gate
items.goal: Declare an authoritative source per shared asset, backport missed hunks so both repositories reconcile, mark intentional variants, and wire a drift gate into both check pipelines.
items.completionDefinition: All in-scope assets reconciled with declared authority; drift gate green in both repos and demonstrably fails on injected drift; constitution role mapping recorded; both suites and plugin skill-delivery samples green.

items.title: Structural Debt Decision Gate
items.goal: Draft six structural design candidates (SD-1 layer sinking, SD-2 Dashboard artifact pipeline, SD-3 V1/V2 convergence, SD-4 MemoryStore ownership, SD-5 Core Wave 3B closeout, SD-6 daemon observability reuse) and obtain a controller decision on each.
items.completionDefinition: Six design notes exist with options, costs, recommendations, and re-verified evidence; each carries an accept/reject/defer decision record; nothing implemented.

items.title: Final Acceptance & Archive
items.goal: Run the full cross-repository gate set on the final state, review raw evidence against each completion definition, annotate audit-item dispositions, and archive the sequence.
items.completionDefinition: All five repository gates plus the drift gate green; AlembicDashboard shows zero code diff; every audit item has a final disposition; acceptance archive written and recorded in the workspace record map.
